# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version of the installer is supported for security updates.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x     | Yes       |
| < 1.0.0 | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this installer project, please send an e-mail to `crasivodev@gmail.com`.
All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
